args.query: access rights roles review six months

gather.answer: Access starts from none and follows the job; rights sit in roles that their owners review every six months. The customer system access review covers the accounts staff hold in customers' systems.

requirements.reason: Access follows the job and is requested, approved and removed as the policy defines.

citations.quote: Access to information is granted on the basis of the job a person does.

requirements.reason: Our own accounts are reviewed half-yearly, and the accounts staff hold in customers' systems are now reviewed each quarter.

citations.quote: The access rights of all accounts, including administrator and technical accounts, are reviewed every six months by the role owners.
The customers closed all five at our request by 7 July 2026 and confirmed it in writing.
We start from no access and add only what the job needs.
